manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
